g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · ASPICE Automotive SPICE, the process capability model · AUD-nn functional safety audit, AUD-n (WP-M-06 §5) · CR-nn confirmation review of the confirmation measures plan (WP-M-06) · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project lifecycle · ISO International Organization for Standardization · PAS

publicly available specification (ISO/PAS 8800 is the AI safety one) · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards with nothing failing · WBS work breakdown structure (WP-M-03 §3) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software,
V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
